headline: Nvidia says open source AI strategy remains intact

lines.en: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress reaffirmed the company's commitment to open source AI on Tuesday's earnings call.
lines.zh: 英伟达临时CEO科莱特·克雷斯在周二的财报电话会议上重申了公司对开源AI的承诺。

lines.en: It was the first call since CEO Jensen Huang resigned.
lines.zh: 这是CEO黄仁勋辞职后的首次电话会议。

lines.en: Kress said Nvidia is committed to fostering a vibrant open model ecosystem.
lines.zh: 克雷斯表示，英伟达致力于培育一个充满活力的开放模型生态系统。

lines.en: She said this lets every country, company, and industry build its own intelligence.
lines.zh: 她说，这让每个国家、公司和行业都能构建自己的智能。

lines.en: She noted that open models were accelerating AI adoption.
lines.zh: 她指出，开放模型正在加速AI的采用。

lines.en: She cited a thirty-five-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter.
lines.zh: 她引用了OpenRouter上周度token量同比增长三十五倍的数据。

lines.en: That includes a three-and-a-half-fold increase over the past three months.
lines.zh: 其中包括过去三个月增长了三倍半。

lines.en: Kress also spoke about Nvidia's plans for Hugging Face, a platform for open source AI models.
lines.zh: 克雷斯还谈到了英伟达对Hugging Face的计划，这是一个开源AI模型平台。
lines.focus: v in vibrant? no; use 'v in Face'? skip

lines.en: Nvidia agreed to acquire it for twelve point nine billion dollars in September.
lines.zh: 英伟达在九月同意以一百二十九亿美元收购它。

lines.en: That would be the second-largest acquisition in Nvidia's history.
lines.zh: 这将是英伟达历史上第二大收购。

lines.en: The platform serves more than eighteen million developers and two hundred thousand companies.
lines.zh: 该平台服务超过一千八百万开发者和二十万家公司。

lines.en: It is still on track to join Nvidia despite Huang's ouster.
lines.zh: 尽管黄仁勋被罢免，该平台仍有望加入英伟达。

lines.en: Kress said together they will scale the platform and make intelligence more open and accessible.
lines.zh: 克雷斯表示，他们将共同扩大平台规模，让智能更加开放和易于获取。

script: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress reaffirmed the company's commitment to open source AI on Tuesday's earnings call. It was the first call since CEO Jensen Huang resigned. Kress said Nvidia is committed to fostering a vibrant open model ecosystem. She said this lets every country, company, and industry build its own intelligence. She noted that open models were accelerating AI adoption. She cited a thirty-five-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter. That includes a three-and-a-half-fold increase over the past three months. Kress also spoke about Nvidia's plans for Hugging Face, a platform for open source AI models. Nvidia agreed to acquire it for twelve point nine billion dollars in September. That would be the second-largest acquisition in Nvidia's history. The platform serves more than eighteen million developers and two hundred thousand companies. It is still on track to join Nvidia despite Huang's ouster. Kress said together they will scale the platform and make intelligence more open and accessible.
